satellites.title: Long and Growing
satellites.evidence: Dictionaries distinguish cháng, long, from zhǎng, grow or elder. Sound distinguishes related semantic lives of one graph.

satellites.title: Long Life, Lasting Sight
satellites.evidence: Daodejing 59 ends: 深根固柢，長生久視之道 — “deep roots and a firm base: the way of long life and lasting vision.” 長 here is cháng, length of time; 長 zhǎng, growing up, is the same graph.
